resolution: Fixed the building paint apply flow. Apply paint now reads the current building face target at click time instead of using the action bar's previously captured target, materializes the current paint, applies it through the store's current-target apply path, and switches back to the MODEL lens on success so the applied skin is immediately visible. This clarifies the expected workflow and removes the stale-target/no-visible-result failure mode the user hit.
